text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Espoir City—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Isn't that one of those Paka Petit 
thingies?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Espoir City 
pointed, I saw a claw crane game filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait here a sec. I'll snag that real 
quick.
choice_data_list: I didn't know you were into Paka Petits.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way. It wasn't me, it was—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Who cares what it is! Just sit 
tight and wait, I'll be done in no time!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! Aaaaargh! Why can't I catch a 
single one, dammit?!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...! I'm not done yet, you hear me, 
hah!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight, obviously! I'm definitely 
gonna win it and give it to my little bro—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Is this for your little brother?
Is this for your little brother?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wha, ngh...! S-Shut up, shut up! Something 
like this is no big deal!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
She's loved racing forever, that's why! I 
just thought grabbing a Paka Puchi for her 
might cheer her up... and that's all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea that was the reason. To try 
so many times, all for the sake of his 
younger brother...
choice_data_list: ...Alright! Just let me try it once!
...Alright! Just let me try it once!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Haaahn? You!? ...Hmph, do whatever the 
hell you want!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
